firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player at random and give that player the first-player token.
clarifications: Players take turns clockwise during each round.
After rounds 1, 2 and 3, pass the first-player token one seat to the left. Its new holder starts the next round; you do not choose a new random starter each round.
This entry covers the base game's standard multiplayer mode with 2-5 human players. Automa, Duet and Flock modes have their own setup instructions.

internalEvidence: Codex rechecked the live official Rulepop reference on 2026-10-17 in a browser under the owner's request to improve affected pages. Selected only the Wingspan standalone set, disabled Wingspan Asia, Americas, European and Oceania, and verified Standard (2-5 players) and Human. Setup > Player step 4 explicitly selects the first player randomly and gives that player the token. First Player (#first-player) says to pass it left at round end and that the recipient starts the next round. Round Structure (#rounds) specifies clockwise turns and, after rounds 1-3, a clockwise token pass; after round 4 the game ends. Removed the previous officialTieBreak sentence because it merely restated setup, rather than a separate official tie-break. No personal criterion or house selection is added. The source HTML includes all selectable modes; the actual selected UI was used to establish the base-game scope. Download custody: research/source-files/indexing-oct17/wingspan-rulepop.html; SHA-256 3a73b87dbb08360f5c15d812567bf8f742a595b6db9e95d41ccb8e40c15efccf. Restored the source website's original displayed expansion settings after review. Prior publisher-link provenance and image review remain recorded in git history and the image record. The exact rule remains excluded from the portable random-rule pool.
